name: datto-edr-mcp
description: MCP server for Datto EDR (formerly Infocyte) - agents, alerts, target groups, organizations, scans, rules and response actions through AI assistants
long_description: Provides AI assistants with structured access to your Datto EDR instance through its LoopBack API. Search agents, triage alerts, review target groups, organizations and locations, follow scans and tasks, list rules and extensions, and (with explicit confirmation) scan or isolate a host. Includes domain navigation, API model discovery, a read-only raw request escape hatch, retries with backoff, and clear error messages.

datto_edr_url.title: Datto EDR instance URL
datto_edr_url.description: Your instance base URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.infocyte.com

datto_edr_api_token.title: Datto EDR API token
datto_edr_api_token.description: Profile > Admin > Users & Tokens > API Tokens

datto_edr_read_only.title: Read-only
datto_edr_read_only.description: Hide the scan, isolate, restore and response tools
